title: UserProfileEfsProgram
description: A user profile's standing in Enterprise Frontier Safeguards, a program under which Anthropic approves the entity the profile represents and may approve any of the program's features.

status.description: Anthropic's decision on the entity the profile represents: `pending` while it is awaited, `active` once Anthropic has approved the entity for the program, or `rejected` once Anthropic has declined or has removed the entity from the program. `active` does not mean that any one feature is approved: read the feature you need in `features`.

features.description: The program's features, keyed by feature: `data_retention_exemption` (use of models that normally require data retention, without the data being retained), `cmek` (customer-managed encryption keys) and `storage` (customer-owned storage). Every feature that the caller's organization may read has a key, whether or not it is approved; a missing key does not mean that the feature is inactive. Anthropic may add features; ignore a key you do not recognize.
